identity.title: Canonical Public Polymarket Identifier Secret-Scanner Compatibility Repair
identity.objective: Repair the consumed AF1 Attempt-03 TRUE_STOP PHASE_B_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_DEFECT caused by the shared HERMES request secret scanner flagging the canonical public Polymarket event id event:polymarket:0x<64 hex> as REQUEST_SECRET_DETECTED. Inside the request field public_market_context only, exact complete canonical public Polymarket market, event and token identifiers survive the generic long-hex rule; the global 0x{40,} rule, every credential rule, every other request field, the authority scan and original-bytes request identity stay unchanged and fail-closed. No schema, policy identity, provider, credential, AF1 successor attempt, H1 #5, Gate C, capital, order or merge authority.

scope.rollback_surface: One private public_market_context-only canonical public Polymarket identifier recognizer and scan helper in models.py plus focused tests and truth docs; no dependency, workflow, schema, policy, argv, managed-config, provider, retry, output-parsing, context-protocol, context-controller, execution, OMS, risk or live-trading change.

api_matrix.reason: The package narrows one existing request-field secret scan; no public signature, field set or schema version changes.

items.before: public_market_context received the same generic secret scan as prose, so the repo-canonical public event id event:polymarket:0x<64 hex> matched the generic 0x{40,} rule and the controlled context request failed REQUEST_SECRET_DETECTED before any backend launch.
items.after: Only inside public_market_context, exact complete canonical public Polymarket market, event and token identifiers are masked in a validation-only copy for the generic long-hex rule; every other secret rule evaluates the original text and the full scanner evaluates the masked copy.
items.compatibility_requirement: Signature, request field set, schema versions, error codes, authority scan, stored bytes and content-addressed request identity are unchanged; every other request field still uses the ordinary strict path.

semantic_fields.reason: Exact grammar, field boundary, unchanged global rules, original-bytes identity, no-echo, no broadening and non-authority are mandatory deterministic semantics.

items.required_rule: Inside public_market_context only, exact complete tokens market:polymarket:<decimal>, event:polymarket:0x<exactly 64 lowercase hex>, event:polymarket:market-<decimal> and token:polymarket:<decimal> are treated as public identifiers for the generic long-hex rule; <decimal> is a non-empty digit string without a leading zero; the 64-hex form follows the repository condition-id contract ^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$.
items.validation_rule: canonical event, long decimal token and market+event+token contexts build valid requests

items.required_rule: Recognition is case-sensitive and bounded by non-identifier characters on both sides; wrong namespace, wrong prefix, 40, 63 or 65 hex, uppercase hex, extra token characters and sk- or other non-grammar payloads are never masked and remain subject to the generic scan.
items.validation_rule: wrong namespace and malformed near-matches fail REQUEST_SECRET_DETECTED

items.required_rule: Only public_market_context uses the public-identifier-aware scan; research_question, research_objective and every other string field keep the ordinary strict _require_str path, so the same canonical or bare 0x64 value is rejected there.
items.validation_rule: same value rejected in research_question and research_objective; source inspection shows one call site

items.required_rule: The generic rule \b0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40,}\b stays in _SECRET_PATTERNS unchanged; bare 0x64 and bare 0x40 values still reject in public_market_context; every non-long-hex secret rule evaluates the original unmasked public_market_context so a credential marker overlapping or adjacent to an identifier cannot be hidden.
items.validation_rule: bare hex and valid-id-plus-credential contexts fail REQUEST_SECRET_DETECTED

items.required_rule: The stored public_market_context and content-addressed request_id derive from the original exact string; the masked copy is validation-only and never stored or hashed.
items.validation_rule: built field equals input and changing one identifier changes request_id

items.required_rule: Rejections raise only the closed code REQUEST_SECRET_DETECTED and never echo rejected content.
items.validation_rule: error text equals the closed code

items.required_rule: A ContextCampaignScope carrying live-shaped canonical market, 0x64 event and long decimal token subject_refs reaches the offline fake backend through the unchanged _context_request and run_blind_phase; a secret-bearing scope still fails before any backend call.
items.validation_rule: fake backend call_count is 1 for live shape and 0 for secret-bearing scope

items.required_rule: No global long-hex allowlist, caller-configurable whitelist, caller-supplied digest, normalization of arbitrary strings or schema, policy-identity, provider, retry or output-parsing change exists; the Hermes invocation policy id is unchanged.
items.validation_rule: module surface and helper signatures expose no broadening hook

items.required_rule: No provider, model, Firecrawl, Polymarket, OAuth, credential, dependency, workflow, scheduler, strategy, paper, execution, live, AF1 successor attempt, H1 number five, Gate C, capital, order or merge authority is granted; AF1 Attempt-03 stays CONSUMED with no gate result.
items.validation_rule: authority booleans remain as mirrored and tests use only offline fake backends

identity_derivations.reason: No content-addressed identity is added or changed; request identity continues to hash the original request fields.
